name: codeception/codeception-api-tests
description: Codeception API tests for a mocked API

scripts.test:dev_sharding: start /b codecept run Api --env dev --shard 1/3 & start /b codecept run Api --env dev --shard 2/3 & codecept run Api --env dev --shard 3/3 & allure serve tests/_output/allure-results
scripts.test:prod_sanity: codecept run Api --env=prod -g sanity --html --debug & start tests/_output/report.html
